description: Round 3 frequency notes: one-liners with polarity, the muscle(s) they name and a link target (muscle id + deep-dive anchor). tools/frequency_notes.py notes(days, level). One line each, no kind words, no claims beyond the model. Frequency notes are scheduling suggestions: volume-equated studies (schoenfeld2019freq, pelland2026) find little growth difference between frequencies, so no note says twice a week grows more.

templates.text: {Muscle}: trained on {n} days, so its sets are spread out.
templates.when: muscle in frequency_muscles with effective days >= 2, only when freq_all_main_twice does not apply

templates.text: Every main muscle gets work on 2+ days.
templates.when: all frequency_muscles at >= 2 days (2+ training days)

templates.text: {Muscle}: only {day_name} this week; a second day would make its sets easier to do well.
templates.when: low_frequency: frequency muscle on 1 day, 2+ training days

templates.text: {Muscle}: no day with 2+ effective sets this week.
{Muscle}: hard on {day1} and {day2} back to back; a day between helps.
{Muscle}: {sets} sets on {day_name}; past about 10 in one session, extra sets add little.
No muscle goes past about 10 sets in one session.

fields.link: {muscle, anchor}: anchor = deepdive-<muscle>-frequency (or -session); null for board-level notes

order: negative first, then positive; muscle notes before board notes; by muscle importance (check-priority-weights.json) then id

replaces.low_frequency message: freq_one_day (no claim that twice a week grows more)
